ShortDescription.Value: Put your districts into groups, then assign a whole group to a service building at once.

Publish.LongDescription:
In the base game you pick which districts a service building serves. You do this for every building, one at a time. If you make a new district or change your mind, you have to edit every building again.
District Groups makes this easier.
**NOTE**
This mod DOES NOT change how the game works. It only fills in the "districts served" list for you.
## How to use it
1. Open the District Groups panel. 2. Make a group. Give it a name, choose a color, and pick a service type like fire or garbage. 3. Add districts to the group. 4. Select a service building. In its info panel, pick a group.
The building now serves every district in that group. Later, when you add or remove a district, every building that uses the group updates by itself.
**NOTE**
It takes a few seconds after assigning a group to a building for the UI to show the change. This is the game simulation catching up.
## Features
1. District Groups: Link several districts together to gain data aggregation and assign to buildings 2. Building assignments: Assign a building to a group to service the districts within the group, and to keep district lists in sync 3. Localized UI 4. Overlay UI: Visualize your district groups with drawn colored areas to see your city coverage of services, as well as spotting your service buildings 5. Service Building Index: See a full list of service buildings by type, to quickly modify their group assignments or fully inspect the building
## Localization
This mod supports all the official languages that CSII does.
Translations are provided by AI tooling, extracting from CSII localization data where possible.
If there are incorrect translations, please [report them on GitHub](https://github.com/Mordil/cs2-district-groups/issues/new).
## Mod Compatability This mod is INCOMPATIBLE with any other mod that modifies the "Operating Districts" section of a building's Info Panel.
## Uninstalling the mod
Loading a save without the mod is generally safe. But if you save the game while the mod is removed, the groups are gone for good.
Service buildings will continue serving the districts as they were assigned before removing the mod. Only the groups are lost.
In Settings, there is a button to safely remove all mod data from your save.
## Roadmap
1. Group Info panel: View an aggregate of wealth, population, etc. of districts in the group. 2. District policy quality of life: Enable/disable district policies for all districts in a group.
Publish.ChangeLog:
**NEW**
Added a new tab to the District Group panel: Service Buildings.
In this view, you can see a list of all service buildings in your city matching the selected filter type. From here, you can quickly change the district group assignment.
With quick actions you can fully inspect the building or jump to where it is in the city.
Looking to update your prior buildings? Click on "hide assigned buildings" to get a smaller list of unassigned buildings.
**CHANGED**
- Optimized mod performance in general, by spreading work across multiple frames - Fixed the width of group metadata items so that the UI is consistenly spaced - Optimized mod performance when the main panel is open to avoid writing updates every frame - Increased the size of the delete group and remove district icons - Increased the font size of the group type selector
**FIXED**
- Fixed district selection in Group Management not ending when you select a different filter option - Fixed the service building filter and selector UI growing too large in certain languages like French - Fixed a shader log error caused by the overlay labels added in v1.0 - The read-only version of the service building Operating Districts link button is now correctly localized - Localization of service building terminology in the mod UI to align with game translations - Localization of the service building Operating Districts tooltip in Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian.
